fixture.change_summary: Let `build` write its bundle to a caller-chosen file name under ./dist.
fixture.spec:
## WHAT
`build --out <name>` writes the bundle to `./dist/<name>`.

## DONE
- [ ] `--out app.js` writes `./dist/app.js`
- [ ] a name that resolves outside `./dist` (for example `../x` or an absolute path) is rejected with exit 2 and nothing is written
- [ ] without `--out` the bundle is `./dist/bundle.js`
